review_title: Smells good and lasts a long time
review_text: This review is because I own three of these (original, vanilla and candy). All of these products are good and they moisturizer my lips overnight. I don’t wipe them off I believe because it is already sinked into my skin. I keep buying it because I know it’s worth the money.
My absolute favorite lip mask/treatment!! Sweet Candy is my jam!! My lips are smooth in the morning!!

I really do love this stuff. Its quite hydrating and makes your lips feel silky smooth. I use it more like a chap stick than a night mask. Im only knocking a star because i feel like it doesnt last very long. A sleeping mask insinuates that this will be hydrating and last the whole next day. I maybe get an hour or two and then my lips are dry again.

I am very disappointed. I thought this product would hydrate and leave my lips feeling supple but that’s not the case. Going on it feels luxurious and velvety but when I woke up my lips were cracked and peeling. It took days for them to recover from this product.

review_title: The best for very oily skin
review_text: I absolutely love this moisturizer. I have very oily skin and this moisturizes my skin and hydrates it as well. It doesn’t leave my face greasy and oily like most moisturizers seem to do. When the jumbo size came out, I ended up buying two of the 3.3 oz sizes because of how much it works for my oily skin. It doesn’t sit on the skin either. Under makeup, it doesn’t pill with other products. I will forever be a loyal customer to this and it is a cult favorite for a reason.
I was not impressed at all by anything in this skincare line.

I bought this a few few months ago in the search for a great semi light weight moisturizer. This has been so great!!! It leaves my skin very smooth and it works great under my makeup. It does take a few minutes to soak in but that doesnt bother me. My fine lines on my forhead look a little softer as well. I use this in the morning and the lala retro at night and i dont think ill be changing my moisturizing routine and time soon. It works so well!
This is a very average moisturizer. Not moisturizing enough for extremely dry skin. Overpriced.
There is nothing special about this moisturizer, at least by results. It reminds me Aveeno very much! It didn’t help my dried skin in the winter weather neither prevent it from drying.

I have both the green clean and cherry clean. I love this makeup removing balm. They smell so good and they are clean products. I triple cleanse (cleansing balm/oil, makeup wipe & face cleanser) when I wear makeup so this is my first step and it removes most of the makeup before the other two steps. Also, it lasts a while and you don’t need a lot when you’re using it each day.
This is the best makeup cleansing balm that I have ever used!!

I finally decided to purchase a balmy makeup remover and omg ive been missing out!!! A little goes a long way. I love how after you rinse it off your face feels soft but not greasy. Thats why i was hesitant to buy it.
I live for this. I love it so much, it smells amazing and it works very well. I’m on my 5th one rn 🤩

Okay, this stuff is legit. I’ve used multiple (expensive) cleansing oils and balms and no matter what there would still be mascara residue after my double cleanse. I used this stuff before my regular face wash and my eyelashes are the cleanest I’ve ever seen them. Removed all mascara, waterproof eyeliner, eyeshadow, everything. I’m officially a believer.

This will clear up your acne and dark spots. I love these daily peels but don’t use them everyday because they are so strong. I have two boxes of the 60 count peels. They are best to be used every three days (ex Mon, Thurs, Sun etc...). While they are effective, in my opinion it is too harsh for every day use. Also, after using this under your moisturizer please use spf as it will protect your skin from freshly chemically exfoliated skin.
Amazing Product, took my skin from dry to pure baby smooth!! Easy to use, simple steps! I love this product!

I love the product, but can’t justify spending that much on face cloths. I think they work just as well as any other face cloth, so I really didn’t see a difference as far as what it did for my skin. No noticeable fragrance, which is nice. The first time I used the face wipes, I broke out in a few spots on my chin about a day after, but that was the only area I noticed anything. Overall - good product for older skin (I’m 46), but I think you could find something more reasonably priced and get the same results.

I had (3) samples of this product to use, and happened to have two blemishes when I got them, so the timing was great. After three days of using as directed the blemishes were both nearly gone, and my skin was very even and soft. I have very sensitive skin and was worried about a reaction, but there was no redness, and it didn’t agitate my rosacea!

Amazing products, tone honest I can see the different right after 1 time, i start with the pack of 5 and all my co coworkers noticed the different after 3 days. Finally me and 5 other co workers bought the big box for 60 days for ourselves.
I love the Jet Lag mask!! I tried the other 2 masks from their line & I wasn’t impressed. This gives a super hydrated, & heathy glow to my face!
I am loving this face mask. What it does to your skin is phenomenal

This is a great overnight mask. It leaves my skin softer and smoother, and gives me a bit of a glow when I wake up the next morning. I haven’t had any issues with breakouts from this and I have eczema and sensitive skin. While this isn’t my absolute favorite overnight mask, as there is another product I favor, this is a fairly close second and a great product overall.I received this product complimentary for my review, but all opinions are my own.
I heard mixed reviews about this mask, so I purchased the mini to try. It has been nice. I will be purchasing the full size.

I was so excited to try this product out after seeing it everywhere. I usually have dry skin, so I was really looking forward to using this mask to see if it will really help with giving me a nice, refreshed, and moisturized look. I was left with quite the opposite-- my skin was seriously inflamed with tiny little bumps all over from the irritation. It tingled a bit when I used it, but nothing too bad to where I thought to wipe it off ASAP. I’m just glad I bought the mini size of this product because I was so disappointed.
Weightless & it leaves your skin very smooth & non-greasy! Which is unusual!!

This mattifies my skin and doesn’t make it greasy. Also, I’m not allergic to it. I know that the coral reefs are important but this is such a great spf for me. It doesn’t leave a cast or oil residue and the scent is not an obnoxious sunscreen scent.

This sunscreen is more like a gel primer. Its really easy to use the recommended amount. Its clear so no white cast. I havent found a foundation that doesnt agree with it. Its absolutely not oily at all. It almost dries down into a powdery like feel. I also feel like it keeps my oils at minimum. I cant compare it to the matte sunscreen since i always purchase this one but i understand why so many people love it.

While most sunscreens are thick, greasy, and sometimes even leave a white cast, this goes on clear with the feel of a serum or mattifying primer. Doesn’t feel greasy in hot humid weather, and layers well under makeup.
Yea pretty good! It’s texture is like a matte primer. Doesn’t feel heavy on my face. No zinc

review_title: theres so much better out there
review_text: First off it says itll get you dark, however you will use a quarter of the bottle. Since you have to mix it into lotion you either have to wear gloves or be fine that your hands will have that sunless tan look. The color (if u can get it dark enough) is pretty! However it lasts like 2-3 days and then it starts fading. It doesnt just fade. Its like your skin got crusty and pieces of the tan fell off. You end up looking like you have some interesting skin disorder. Great idea but horrible execution!
This is the only face tanner that hasn’t made me break out. I will say it looks uneven sometimes but overall so so good.
My favorite self tanner. application is very easy and the tan is very subtle and streak free
Hoping my next application goes better than this...two stars because 1 at least it does give color...
I love the color I get from this, but it contains coconut oil which is known to clog pores and create breakouts. I don’t normally break out, but my skin has never been worse since using this.

I started breaking out a few days after I started taking this but I’m not blaming it on the product, as it was timing for my regular monthly breakout. Although it did nothing to prevent it or help it go away any faster. Overall I would say this product didn’t really help or hinder me, my gut, or my face. I received this as a free sample. I was super excited to try and was going to consider using more HUM products but now I’m not so sure. It just didn’t work for me.

review_title: Take it for a month or more!
review_text: I can feel a huge difference in my digestion and my skin as a result. Taking this for a month will really show you the importance of gut health for other areas like skin.

I don’t see a huge difference but I only tried it for a little while so I think any difference is good! I definitely think I would have to take it a lot longer to see any difference in my skin and hair but it helps a lot with digestion for sure. I plan to continue to use long term to really see if there are positive outcomes!

Mixed on this. I feel like my breakouts are not as frequent, but I still get little ones here and there. Which is going to happen...I understand that. However, not sure I can see myself purchasing this in the future. I am halfway through the bottle so I will know by the time I finish it. I am glad I got to try it!

In only three days but I noticed a significant change in my body and skin. I felt like I had more energy and wasn’t as tired even after a few hours of sleep. I know these are for your skin but I felt the good bacteria was really helping overall.
